# Documentation theme

The page template (`page.html`), stylesheet (`docs.css`), and version
switcher (`docs.js`) of Slath's documentation, built by
`slath docs build` and served at `/-/docs/` by every installation. The
website slath.org copies these files, so the documentation looks the same
in both places. They're under the Apache License 2.0 so the website can use
them; the documentation text is CC-BY-SA-4.0.

The generator adds the Weave tokens (`web/src/tokens.css`), the interface
font, and the logos next to them under `_theme/`.
